description: This file defines server-side logic for the accounts list page in a SvelteKit application. It handles loading account data from a Django REST API, transforming the data for frontend use, and includes actions for creating, updating, activating, deactivating, and deleting accounts.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches accounts data from the API, processes and transforms it for display, and returns it along with filter options and pagination info.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new account by sending a POST request to the API with form data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing account by sending a PATCH request with form data.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates an account by setting its 'is_active' field to false via API PATCH.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates an account by setting its 'is_active' field to true via API PATCH.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an account via API DELETE request.
